comparison: same-build CPU binary64 normalization + exact tree vs Metal centered-integer FP32 normalization + resident greedy selection

accuracy: Independent strict GT: position <=2 px, angle <=1 degree, relative scale <=2%; report all calls and exact ordered output differences, never use GT in worker.
performance_budget: Every paired block: resident <= control + max(2 ms,10% of control). Passing budget does not prove acceleration.
memory_budget: Peak RSS <= control + max(8 MiB,10% of control). GPU buffer capacities are overlapping accounting, not added to RSS.
numeric_contract: Preserve gray8 exact integer moments; integer centering before FP32. Not binary64-identical. Greedy geometry and score/y/x ties retained for computed scores.
scope: Resident coarse NCC + normalization + greedy peaks; CPU coarse rotation, endpoint-table setup, compact handoff, fine control/repair/normalization and final NMS remain.
limits: One coarse canvas <=64 MiB gray8; one score map <=64 MiB FP32; 65025*N*N <= UINT64_MAX; limit 1..10016; async CPU overlap incompatible; violations throw.
hypotheses: Less dense CPU readback can reduce RSS and host work.
Single-workgroup greedy decisions may limit GPU occupancy and scale poorly with candidate count.
retention: Retain source, raw pilot/formal/validation, and unsuccessful results for CUDA comparison; no GUI/default change.
